title: The Annunciation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Luke 1:26-38: God sends Gabriel to Mary in Nazareth, she will have a son by the Holy Spirit and name him Jesus, nothing is impossible with God (1:37), and Mary answers "I am the Lord's servant"; this birth is unique.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Jesus grew up in Nazareth.
floor.question: What was Jesus' hometown?

representations: a map with Nazareth and Bethlehem
steps: Who was sent, and to whom?
What name was the child to have?
contexts: waiting for news of a new baby in the family

board.do: Write two towns: Nazareth and Bethlehem.

board.say: Where was Mary when Gabriel came?

board.do: Wait for the child to say Nazareth.

misconceptions.ask: To whom did the angel Gabriel bring the news of Jesus' birth?
misconceptions.repair: Make two columns: Zechariah and Mary, and place the facts.

misconceptions.ask: Where was Mary when the angel came to her?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 1:26 and then say where Jesus was born later.

misconceptions.ask: What name did the angel tell Mary to give her son?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 1:31 and Luke 1:13 and compare.

misconceptions.ask: What did Mary finally say to the angel (Luke 1:38)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 1:34 and 1:38 together. Asking a question is not saying no.

checks.question: What name did Gabriel tell Mary to give her son?
What did Mary say at the end?
